'''Morbo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal that owned a [[Morbo's Paradise|club]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3640 BBY]]. He was involved in several illicit activities including [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. While working as a smuggler, he came into conflict with the [[Old Tion Brotherhood]] of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Teff'ith]] and wanted them [[Death/Legends|dead]].

In [[3640 BBY]], Morbo was planning to sell some [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prisoners off as [[Slavery|slaves]], this caused an undercover [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] operation targeted at him. The [[Unidentified Cathar sergeant|slaves]] that Morbo was planning to sell were freed by [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] Operative, [[Theron Shan]].
